name: Vandenberg SLC-4E
best_known_for: Polar / sun-synchronous gateway — Falcon 9 to Starlink + national-security + earth-observation
credit: West-coast Falcon 9 pad at Vandenberg Space Force Base. Originally an Atlas-Agena pad (1963-1967); Titan III/IV from 1972 to 2005; refit by SpaceX in 2011 and now flies Falcon 9 to polar / sun-synchronous orbits — the geometry the East Coast can't reach because the launch corridor crosses populated land. Starlink shells, NRO payloads, USSF + commercial earth-observation. Coordinates from FAA + USSF public records.
